description: The Phase 13 garden on a 70' square lot that falls about 7' to the street, read by an implementation of FS_site that knows it: setbacks of 25' at the front, 5' at the sides and 10' at the rear; a survey of five spot elevations and two contour lines; the patio, a patio slab stepped 6" down, and a pad under the house 8" below its floor. It is valid, reports nothing - the house, its patio and its pad are clear of the setbacks, and the survey covers the lot - and derives the lot's area and its edges (front, side, rear, side, each 70' with its setback), the surface's eleven points and their triangles, and the cut and fill under the pad and the patio.
